scripts.build: npm run check && vite build --outDir dist/client && vite build -c vite.server.config.ts
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.sim.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && node scripts/lint-sim.mjs
scripts.start: if [ ! -f dist/server/main.js ] || [ ! -f dist/client/index.html ] || [ -n "$(find src server index.html package.json vite.config.ts vite.server.config.ts -newer dist/server/main.js -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ]; then npm run build; fi && node dist/server/main.js
